title: East Nashville Dream Retreat Guesthouse - STR
description:
This stylish guesthouse is perfect for family trips. 2 bedrooms, ( third pull out bed available)2 full baths, & loft ceilings throughout,  Pull out queen bed  to accommodate up to a party of 6. Fully equipped kitchen provides a welcome retreat to recharge. Retire at night in either the King or Queen bed, draw the room darkening shades, and dim the lights to create a cozy space to wind down in . A short 10 min trip gets you to key downtown locations. Charming  coffee shops within walking distance

The space
Main suite bedroom w/ King size bed and full bath

Second bedroom w/ Queen size bed and full bath 

Living Room / Kitchen open to each other 

Pull out queen memory foam mattress available, which is in the living room

All three spaces have tall loft ceilings

Guesthouse is located on 2nd floor, with private lighted entrance off of alley .

Guest access
both bedrooms, both bathrooms, living room/ kitchen are available to the guest of this space
